name: Himekami Mine
source: [url=/c20899]Akane's[/url] younger sister. Because of her weak body, she is often forced to stay at home and believes to be a burden to both Akane and their parents. Due to this, she often tries her best to be independent and not rely on Akane all the time.
translation: [url=/c20899]Akane's[/url] younger sister. Because of her weak body, she is often forced to stay at home and believes to be a burden to both Akane and their parents. Due to this, she often tries her best to be independent and not rely on Akane all the time.
